name: Nur Navoi Solar (100 MW), Uzbekistan
monitoring_objective: Turn the issuer's self-reported allocation and impact into independently observed evidence.

disclosure.title: Nur Navoi Solar (100 MW): Self-Reported Green/SDG Allocation & Impact
disclosure.issuer: Masdar (Nur Navoi Solar FE LLC) / Government of Uzbekistan
disclosure.instrument: Development finance (use-of-proceeds); issuer self-reported SDG & impact figures
disclosure.summary: Issuer-reported allocation and impact for a 100 MW utility-scale solar PV plant financed by ADB, EBRD and World Bank-IFC. Capacity, generation and CO2-avoided figures are self-reported with only limited (paper) assurance and were never physically verified.

claims.source_span: "...expected annual generation of approximately 270 GWh..." (impact report p.5)
"...avoiding around 156,000 tonnes of CO2 per year..." (impact report p.5)
"...site area of approximately 240 hectares..." (impact report p.6)
"...commercial operation reached in August 2021..." (impact report p.6)

localization.method: Region hint reconciled with the published site boundary and Sentinel-2 imagery of the AOI.

alternatives_rejected.name: Sherabad Solar (Surxondaryo region)
alternatives_rejected.reason: Masdar sister plant ~500 km south; different region and scale than the disclosure

trace.source: Region hint, published site boundary, Sentinel-2 imagery

localization.aoi_assurance: Digitised footprint from the published site boundary, not a box drawn round a point.

observation_series.note: Pre-construction baseline: bare desert terrain, no panel structures.
Construction well advanced; panel rows across most of the AOI ahead of the Aug 2021 target.
Panel footprint measured from the OSM plant polygon (way 1105486434) at ~264 ha, +10% vs the disclosed ~240 ha. Operational as of Aug 2021 (Sentinel-1 backscatter +1.2 dB).

cross_check.variance: ~+10% vs disclosed 240 ha (measured OSM plant footprint, way 1105486434)

cross_check.observed: Full panel field energized in imagery by Sep 2021; on-time commissioning confirmed.
Modelled 149-194 GWh/yr (PVWatts + ERA5 GHI); conservative vs self-reported ~270 GWh.

Modelled 82,000-107,000 tCO2/yr (our conservative estimate: generation x Uzbekistan grid factor 0.551). Below the self-reported 156,000 - the gap is largely the grid-factor choice, not over-reporting.
cross_check.variance: reported 156k sits above our conservative modelled band (grid-factor-driven)

trace.source: PVWatts generation x UNFCCC grid factor 0.551 (modelled)

confidence.rationale: Satellite is the sole source. Sentinel-1 shows a +1.2 dB backscatter rise 2019->2024 (structures / operation), consistent with commissioning in 2021 after 2020 financing - additionality consistent. Generation and avoided-CO2 are conservative PVWatts estimates from ERA5 GHI (1,869 kWh/m2/yr) x grid factor 0.551: 150-194 GWh/yr and 82,000-107,000 tCO2/yr, both below the issuer's self-reported 270 GWh / 156,000 tCO2 - the gap is largely the grid factor and the conservative lower-bound method, not evidence of over-report. Physical risk Low (composite 5/100). Screening: partially consistent - build confirmed, but generation/avoided are estimates, not metered output. Panel footprint measured from the OSM plant polygon (way 1105486434) at ~264 ha, +10% vs the disclosed ~240 ha - consistent.
drivers: Build confirmed: Sentinel-1 backscatter +1.2 dB 2019->2024; commissioning 2021 after 2020 financing - additionality consistent
Generation 150-194 GWh/yr and avoided 82k-107k tCO2/yr (PVWatts + ERA5 GHI 1,869 x grid 0.551) - conservative estimates below self-reported 270 GWh / 156k tCO2
Physical risk Low (composite 5/100): fire 5, flood 0, degradation 0
OSM-measured plant footprint ~264 ha (way 1105486434), +10% vs the disclosed ~240 ha - consistent

limitations: confirms build/land-cover change, not generation output
generation/CO2 figures are a proxy that needs ground truth to certify
evidence.financial_relevance: Construction footprint and commissioning indicator relevant to use-of-proceeds monitoring.

limitations: high-resolution basemap timelapse for visual context; the basemap refresh date lags real events, so it is not the dated capture each observation was measured from
shows the build-out to the eye; the measurements come from the Sentinel observation series
evidence.financial_relevance: A dated high-resolution timelapse of the AOI (Esri World Imagery Wayback): visual confirmation of the desert-to-panels build-out alongside the measured evidence.
